reading: Bar missed (held-out GSE40012 0.773, held-out GSE74224 0.682; mean 0.727, 95% patient-cluster interval 0.636-0.810). Read this with the power statement recorded before the run: the study can detect transfer at or above a true AUROC of about 0.85 and not below it. So this is 'transfer at or above ~0.85 not detected' — not 'no transfer'.
power_stated_before_run: Simulated from cluster counts alone (27 infectious / 13 sterile patients in the locked cohort, 74 / 31 in discovery), 20 replicate datasets per level: the interval's lower bound clears 0.70 in 2/20 replicates at a true transfer AUROC of 0.75, 6/20 at 0.80, 18/20 at 0.85 and 20/20 at 0.90. The study is powered to detect transfer at or above roughly 0.85 and NOT below it. A miss is therefore reported as 'transfer at or above ~0.85 not detected', never as 'no transfer'.
